facts.text: 唐书远 is a close personal friend of Mia's household. Mia writes casually to him as 老唐 or 书远.

evidence.quote: 下周末来我们家吃饭吧

facts.text: 唐书远 was on the 华人文化节 organising committee (组委会), and Mia volunteered under him. In festival mails Mia calls him 唐书远老师 and uses 您.

evidence.quote: 感谢您和组委会的信任

facts.text: 唐书远 and Victor shared a bunk bed (上下铺) at college.

evidence.quote: 你和 Victor 大学睡上下铺的照片我找到了

facts.text: 苏晴, whom Mia calls 苏晴姐, is his partner. Mia treats the two of them as a couple.

evidence.quote: 苏晴姐说不用带甜点
给你们俩补补

facts.text: He was looking for a Chinese school for 朵朵 (most likely his child). Mia connected him with 林小雨, whose older daughter spent two years at a school in Cupertino.

evidence.quote: 想给朵朵找中文学校
她家姐姐在 Cupertino 那家上了两年

facts.text: In November 2024 Mia and Victor went to a Saturday barbecue at his place. Victor brought his new smoker, and Mia brought marinated chicken wings and drinks.

evidence.quote: Victor 说要把他新买的 smoker 搬过来
我们带腌好的鸡翅和饮料

facts.text: In March 2025 Mia found the college bunk-bed photo and suggested showing it as a slideshow at a weekend party.

evidence.quote: 周末聚会的时候放 slideshow 怎么样

facts.text: For the 华人文化节 on September 26, 2026, Mia ran the sign-in desk from 9:00 to 12:00 and Victor handled stage audio all day.

evidence.quote: 我负责签到台，上午 9:00 到 12:00
Victor 负责舞台音响，全天

facts.text: Mia designed the festival poster. She promised it for his review by September 10, then sent bilingual Chinese and English drafts with the organiser's name at the top, as he had asked.

evidence.quote: 9 月 10 日前发给您审核
主办单位的名称放在了最上方

facts.text: Mia trusts his judgement personally. She privately asked him whether the poster colors were too bright.

evidence.quote: 你私下帮我看看颜色是不是太亮

facts.text: At the festival, 苏晴's osmanthus cakes (桂花糕) sold out and many people asked where to buy them.

evidence.quote: 苏晴姐的桂花糕被抢光了

facts.text: In late September 2026 Mia invited 唐书远 and 苏晴 to dinner at her home the following weekend.
